content:
eval-bot: Nightly eval alert: 3 suites failed (longcontext, structured-output, financial-cohort). Run: run-2026-03-19-22:00 id=run-432987. Model: redwood-v4-serve-int4. Severity: medium-high. Quick metrics: longcontext perplexity +12%, structured-output truncation rate +18%.

sam: ...can you paste the run id + commit? who wants to own initial triage?

eval-bot: run-id: run-432987, commit: a1c9f7e, quant profile: int4-kvcache, hardware: p4d.affected_buckets: [longcontext,structout,fin-cohort]

maria: is prod traffic affected or just nightly? :eyes:

sam: just nightly alerts so far, no prod drops in metrics. i'll take first pass. assigning to myself.

jenna: first guess: quantization/kv-cache interaction. recent kvcache change merged in a1c9f7e? @sam can you confirm diff?

sam: checking diff... yes kvcache buffer align tweak in runtime. i'll rerun minimal reproducer with fp16 baseline and int4 variant.

ops-bot: rerun job queued: jobs/repro-432987-sam (cmd: ./eval_run --suite longcontext --model redwood-v4-serve-int4)

sam: quick results: fp16 baseline pass (scores within historical), int4 reproduces failure. snippet of model output for structured-output:
```
input: "extract json from text"
output(int4): ""
output(fp16): "{\"name\": \"Alice\", \"id\": 123}\n"
```

tariq: saw intermittent empty outputs on int4 in a different cohort last week, might be related to prefix caching bug.

jenna: sounds like kv-cache eviction or pointer bug. can you dump kvcache sizes / last-kv-step from logs?

sam: pasted log excerpt:
```
[kv-cache] alloc_ok size=65536 used=65536 last_step=2048
[kv-cache] evict_triggered at 2048
[generation] token_loop hitting zero-length output frame
```

maria: putting severity = P2 (user-impact potential if this leaks to dedicated). please alert eng-runtime for immediate eyeball. @eng-runtime

eng-runtime: looking. ETA 15m to repro locally with same commit.

sam: next steps: 1) open issue with logs + repro 2) fast rollback of kvcache tweak on staging to confirm 3) run cross-quant comparisons for other models 4) hold off rollouts for new int4 profiles until fixed. i'll open the ticket and tag.

sam: created ticket INF-1973 with reproducer and logs, CC @eng-runtime @jenna @maria

jenna: if rollback fixes, we can schedule hotfix. if not, need bisect on kernel selection path.

maria: ok thanks team. i'll update eval-alert channel and product on the status. flagging for on-call if we see production signal. :white_check_mark:

sam: will follow up with patch/PR link and handoff once eng-runtime confirms repro.

eng-runtime: reproduced locally, root-cause candidate: kvcache eviction racing with quantized attention buffer free. prototyping fix now.

sam: marking thread owner=sam, severity=P2, next-update in 60m. moving discussion to INF-1973 thread for postmortem and deeper debugging.

maria: thanks, closing quick triage here. ping if anything escalates.
